Synthetic replay endpoint, not production host. Delays are per message delivery, not network emulation.

recovery.scope: Actual loopback TLS stream including handshake, WebSocket upgrade/framing, WASM applied acknowledgements and simulated presented acknowledgements; excludes TCP/IP headers, browser assets, authorization service, rendering and input. Synthetic replay endpoint, not production host. Delays are per message delivery, not network emulation.

Synthetic replay endpoint, not production host. Delays are per message delivery, not network emulation.
